description: Who this Ploa token belongs to and what it may do: its access level (read, draft, submit, production), whether its owner made it autonomous (then App Review, production, prices, testers and products go straight through instead of waiting for a person's approval), and how the person chose this agent works. choose records the person's answer to ploa_setup_guide's first question, and only theirs: "approvals" (each review, release and price change waits for their OK in Ploa) is kept at once; "autonomous" is only asked for: it returns a link where the person, signed in to Ploa, confirms it for this agent (an agent can never make itself autonomous). Without choose it only reads.

choose.description: The person's answer: how this agent works from now on.
